tiles.label: The Last Update
tiles.defaultTopic: a log entry from the day the system changed everything
tiles.promptSeed: Write a personal log entry from a near-future setting, documenting an ordinary day disrupted by a software or system update that quietly changes something fundamental about daily life.
tiles.description: A log entry from the day the system changed everything.

tiles.label: Tomorrow's Rules
tiles.defaultTopic: a new regulation reshaping an ordinary day
tiles.promptSeed: Write about an ordinary near-future day reshaped by a new rule or regulation, focusing on the mundane logistics of adapting to it rather than the politics behind it.
tiles.description: A new regulation, and the small ways it reshapes an ordinary day.

tiles.label: Small Machines
tiles.defaultTopic: the tiny automation you stopped noticing
tiles.promptSeed: Write about noticing, for the first time in years, one of the small automated systems that quietly run daily life, and the strange feeling of really seeing it.
tiles.description: The tiny automation you stopped noticing, until you did.

tiles.label: The New Normal
tiles.defaultTopic: the moment a strange new reality started to feel ordinary
tiles.promptSeed: Write about the specific, small moment someone realizes a recent, once-strange change to the world has become completely unremarkable to them.
tiles.description: The moment a strange new reality started to feel ordinary.

tiles.label: Signal Lost
tiles.defaultTopic: the last transmission before the silence
tiles.promptSeed: Write the final transmission log from a spacecraft or outpost losing contact with home, capturing the calm procedural tone breaking down as the silence sets in.
tiles.description: The last transmission before the silence.

tiles.label: The Long Voyage
tiles.defaultTopic: a journal entry, years into a voyage with decades left
tiles.promptSeed: Write a journal entry from someone years into a multi-decade space voyage, reflecting on how time and distance have changed their sense of home.
tiles.description: A journal entry, years into a voyage with decades left to go.

tiles.label: First Contact
tiles.defaultTopic: the moment of realizing you are not alone out there
tiles.promptSeed: Describe the moment a crew or outpost first receives unmistakable evidence of non-human intelligence, focusing on the disorientation of the moment rather than what follows.
tiles.description: The moment of realizing you are not alone out there.
constraints: Stop before any resolution or response

tiles.label: Between Stars
tiles.defaultTopic: the vast, quiet nothing between one star and the next
tiles.promptSeed: Describe the experience of the empty space between star systems, focusing on scale, silence, and what it does to the mind of whoever is out there in it.
tiles.description: The vast, quiet nothing between one star and the next.

tiles.label: The Device
tiles.defaultTopic: something that shouldn't exist, found somewhere it shouldn't be
tiles.promptSeed: Write about discovering an unfamiliar device with capabilities that don't match anything currently known, and the immediate uncertainty over what to do with it.
tiles.description: Something that shouldn't exist, found somewhere it shouldn't be.

tiles.label: Malfunction
tiles.defaultTopic: when the technology you rely on starts doing something it shouldn't
tiles.promptSeed: Write about a piece of everyday technology beginning to behave in a way that shouldn't be possible, and the escalating unease of trying to explain it away.
tiles.description: When the technology you rely on starts doing something it shouldn't.

tiles.label: What It Showed Me
tiles.defaultTopic: a machine that revealed something you weren't meant to see
tiles.promptSeed: Write about a piece of technology briefly revealing information it wasn't supposed to show — a glimpse of something hidden — before returning to normal, and the aftermath of having seen it.
tiles.description: A machine that revealed something you weren't meant to see.

tiles.label: The Upgrade
tiles.defaultTopic: a technological enhancement, and what it quietly costs
tiles.promptSeed: Write about someone reflecting on a technological upgrade or enhancement they received, weighing what it gave them against what it subtly took away.
tiles.description: A technological enhancement, and what it quietly costs.
